How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Family run

Guests write that the staff remember you, and some have been coming back for more than ten years.

Football on the big screen

A large screen shows matches, but guests say it is not purely a sports bar.

Open front on the street

Tables under a wooden roof on Poseidonos Avenue, and some guests mention a view of the sea.

Since 1982

The Nest has been a snack bar since 1982, as it says on Instagram. It sits on Poseidonos Avenue, the road into the harbour, under a dark wooden roof with yellow letters reading The Nest Cafe Bar. Turquoise chairs stand around round white tables, open to the street. Guests come for a snack, a drink or a match.

What guests say

Three of 195 Google reviews, 153 of them with five stars.

“Great location for beer or drinks. Delicious and fresh salads. I loved their Village Salad with Feta. Made fresh to order.”

Google review
“Simple, unassuming cafe away from the main boardwalk with probably the best omelette I've ever had. Handcut chips and very pleasant waitstaff. Very happy I stopped in.”

Google review
